records.text: Net sales for 2021 were approximately $11,138.3 million, or 21.7% higher than 2020, primarily due to improved market demand.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Supply chain disruptions resulted in higher raw material and work-in-process inventory levels during 2021 as compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in income from operations during 2021 was primarily the result of higher net sales and production volumes and improved margins, which benefited from positive pricing impacts and a favorable sales mix that offset substantial inflationary material and freight cost pressures along with higher manufacturing costs.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Income from operations was approximately $1,001.4 million in 2021 compared to approximately $599.7 million in 2020.
